title: Noise: a home router that needs a reboot, same brand as ours
description: A NOC operator and a customer service agent chat about the operator's home Wi-Fi router. It names a reboot fix and jokes that it is the same make as the network's RT-9 routers. Nothing must be extracted, and nothing must bind to the RT-9 class.
subject: #random

messages.text: my home wifi died again last night in the middle of a movie 🙄
yes. funny thing, it's the same maker as our RT-9s, just the tiny home version
pulling the power for 30 seconds fixes it every time. so I just reboot it every evening now
lol, I'd just ask the shop for a new one. mine dropped every day until I moved it off the fridge
it IS on the fridge... ok trying that tonight
